Name: Gravel Path sfx to Grass sfx
Author: Rozabel
Description:
Simply changes the sound file used for gravel from dirtyHit to grassyStep, working in 1.6
Requires Content Patcher
Should be compatible with mods that change the texture file used for gravel, as long as its in the same texture space on the spritesheet?

Disclaimer:
I don't know a lot about modding, it might not be compatible with your other path mods. But what it does is really simple so if you have conflicts, you can try to merge the content file with what you use.
